nom: La Roche-Posay Redermic R Anti-Aging Retinol Serum

segments.combination: The reviewers with combination skin report the cream absorbs quickly without irritation or flaking on the face, though one notes her jawline and neck, where she was not applying it, kept breaking out regardless.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including several with rosacea who say retinol usually irritates them, consistently report this one is gentle enough to use regularly without irritation, dryness, or redness, alongside visible smoothing of fine lines.
segments.mature: Most reviewers who mention their age, from their 30s to 60s, report smoother texture and visibly softened lines, several saying they are told they look years younger; the exception is a 53-year-old longtime retinol user who says this one did nothing for her even at the highest strength after three tubes.

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers report visibly softened fine lines, wrinkles, or expression lines, often within one to a few weeks, with several saying they are told they look years younger; dissent includes one longtime retinol user in her 50s who saw no change after three tubes at the highest strength, and a couple of reviewers who say results are simply slower to appear in some areas, like the forehead, or take longer at an older age.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the cream is not drying and even find it moisturizing, some pairing it with a moisturizer as instructed; one reviewer dissents strongly, describing it as drying enough to leave dry patches on her nose and chin even when layering a hydrating mask on top.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports her face turned completely red, splotchy, and painful after about a week of use; by contrast, several reviewers with rosacea or pink, reactive cheeks report zero irritation, and one even uses it to calm redness on emerging pimples overnight.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report dark spots, sunspots, or post-acne marks visibly fading over one to two tubes, including one whose pigmentation, resistant to laser treatment, finally responded; even reviewers with good results sometimes note one stubborn spot that does not fully clear.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers note an initial purging phase with some breakouts in the first weeks that clears into smoother skin with continued use, and one uses the cream as a spot treatment on emerging pimples overnight with good results; one reviewer with combination skin saw no breakouts on her face at all, though her jawline and neck continued breaking out regardless.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers report their pores and sebaceous filaments look smaller with continued use, and several describe the formula itself as non-greasy despite being a rich retinol cream.

aspects.libelle: Strong fragrance despite being marketed fragrance-free
Packaging can crack or gush, wasting product
A little goes a long way, good value
Increases sun sensitivity, strict SPF required

extraits.texte: I received this free to sample and provide a review. I used it for just over a week, didn't go out into the sun (or leave my house even) and by the end of the week, my face was completely red and splotchy and hurt. I've used retinol creams before so I'm not entirely sure what happened, but I won't be using this again. I ended up gifting the remainder to a friend in hopes that she had success where I didnt.

extraits.titre: Good texture but has done nothing
extraits.texte: Im a 53 year old using all types of retinol for the last several years. I've never had peeling or any reactions people talk about with otc retinol. I started slowly with the lowest and worked my way up to 1%...which is this one...have used about three tubes. My skin looked better before using this...might be my life change..but this 1% has done nothing...liked some other brands at .50 which I did see results
Beautiful formula but beware - it is a little drying. Even using Summer Fridays Jet Lag mask on top to help moisturize is not enough for me. I still wake up with dry patches on my nose and chin.

extraits.titre: Great retinol for sensitive, aging skin
extraits.texte: Very good retinol product for aging, sensitive skin. I was able to use it regularly as soon as I started it -- without any irritation. That's unusual for me, as my sensitive skin usually reacts badly to retinol products and I usually give up. This one's gentle and seems to be effective, but as other smart reviewers pointed out, this type of product takes time and results don't show right away. My only complaint is the fragrance -- which is way too strong for a product that's touted for sensitive skin. It would be a five-star item if it weren't for that!

What even is this!!? I have used this for 4 days!! I have been wanting filler in my forehead fine line wrinkles and my 11 lines were soooo deep. After 4 days. 4 DAYS!! Of using this. My 11 lines are almost gone! GONE! They are almost not noticeable at all. It's been crazy!! I went right into using this twice a day morning and night with ZERO problems, breakouts, dry skin. I have had zero problems. I have combination skin. What's funny is the lower part of my jaw and neck line is breaking out and the tula acne moisturizer dried my skin out but not this! I'm telling you BUY THIS! I thought it was pricey too but it's miracle in a bottle I'm not lieing I swear. I never thought I'd ever get rid of my fine forehead lines let alone my deep 1q lines. I'm 32 have 2 kids. I was a heavy smoker through middle school till about I was 24 years old. Took a big toll on how my skin aged. This has reversed so many years in my forehead and 11 lines. This bottle will easily last me 6 months if not longer. A teeny little bit goes so far. Its been life changing. Now if only that stubborn jaw line and neck acne would go away 😒 Again buy this. You won't regret it!!

After years of having lasers to remove sunspots have proven to be ineffective, I read that retinol helps and bought the Redermic R to try. At the end of one tube, I saw marked improvement in my pigmentation. By the end of two tubes, the pigmentation on my cheek is gone. There is still a a small stubborn spot on my nose, but I can live with that. The cream is also wonderful for treating pimples. If you feel a breakout is imminent, apply to the area the night before, and usually the pain and redness will subside by the next morning. I am quite prone to skin tag, and I find this also helps to prevent it from recurring. Been using nightly on my face and neck for almost a year now. Definitely on my nightly routine.

Incredible!! I have roseacea and I use this on my cheeks and under eyes. The first time I used it I forgot to add moisturizer first and woke up to dewy skin with softened lines! I LOVE AND AM RECOMMENDING TO EVERYONE!!!!! Zero irritation even on my pink cheeks!!
